difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a ring map A -> B with standard resolution epsilon : P_bullet -> B and pi as in the pi-equation, one has Lpi_!(F) = F(P_bullet, epsilon) in D(Ab) resp. D(B), functorially in F (source lines 494-504). The proof applies the identification of the lower shriek by polynomial resolutions: the first hypothesis holds because the terms P_n are polynomial algebras, and the second is obtained through a chain of three simplicial inputs — the standard resolution map is a homotopy equivalence of simplicial sets, hence induces a quasi-isomorphism of associated complexes, hence is a trivial Kan fibration.
